prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a NEW original photographic campaign asset for Frontaliere Ticino, a service that finds Swiss job offers suitable for a person's trade and prepares the applications for them. The provided images are REFERENCE IMAGES for the intended audience and practical working-world visual language, not edit targets; do not copy their layout, text, person identity or branding verbatim. Audience is ordinary Italian-speaking job seekers, especially tradespeople, production, maintenance and logistics workers. Visually direct, trustworthy and immediately Swiss; not luxury-office, fintech, abstract CV stationery or aspirational executive advertising. Premium realistic commercial photography with strong clear shapes, authentic faces, practical workwear, crisp focus, decisive contrast. Natural Swiss-red, navy and real workwear colors. A Swiss national flag can appear clearly in the environment (not a humanitarian Red Cross emblem). No company logos, no invented employer, no salary or job guarantee. No embedded words, lettering, numerals, icons, badges or button; the real advertisement will add very large HTML headline 'LAVORO IN SVIZZERA? LO CERCHIAMO NOI PER TE.' and CTA above/beside this photo. The image itself must feature the intended worker prominently, with a strong recognisable human face even at 100px crop width. Aspect LANDSCAPE3:1. An authentic skilled maintenance technician around45 in practical navy overalls in a Swiss precision workshop; natural feminine appearance, capable direct expression, a safely held unbranded hand tool at waist level. Worker face and chest in RIGHT35%; LEFT65% understated softly defocused workshop equipment, dark navy/slate tones, not a pristine executive desk. A small unmistakable Swiss national flag in the workshop. Strong face silhouette at very small horizontal banner size, realistic practical world, no stagey handshake.
